title: RentGuard Renters Policy — Applying Payments, Returned Payments and Billing-Plan Changes
content:
## Billing manual rules

**Application of payments.** A payment on a RentGuard Renters Policy is applied to the balance oldest charge first, and it is recorded with its confirmation or check number exactly as issued.

**Returned payments.** A payment returned unpaid by the bank reverses, in full, the one payment entry it references. A payment that has already been returned is never returned again; a payment has been returned when the premium account shows a returned-payment entry referencing it.

**EFT suspension.** When the number of returned payments on the policy in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the return date — counting the one being posted — reaches the tier's returned-payment count that suspends EFT:
- EFT is suspended for the rest of the term;
- a policy on the monthly EFT plan is moved to the monthly card plan and loses the autopay discount from the date of the move, re-rated under the rating rules;
- the suspension resets at renewal.

**Billing-plan changes requested by the named insured.**
- A change is accepted only to a plan the tier offers, and never to the monthly EFT plan while EFT is suspended.
- A change is re-rated for the autopay discount from the change date.
- A billing-plan change is made only while the policy is in force or pending nonrenewal, as shown on the policy record.

## Plan-change table

| Policy status | Plan requested | EFT suspended | Change made |
|---|---|---|---|
| in force or pending nonrenewal | a plan the tier offers, other than monthly EFT | — | yes |
| in force or pending nonrenewal | monthly EFT, offered by the tier | no | yes |
| in force or pending nonrenewal | monthly EFT | yes | no |
| in force or pending nonrenewal | a plan the tier does not offer | — | no |
| bound, pending cancellation, cancelled or expired | any | — | no |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- On a tier whose EFT-suspension count is 2, a monthly EFT policy with one returned payment eight months ago and a second returned today reaches 2 today: EFT is suspended for the rest of the term and the policy moves to the monthly card plan from today, without the autopay discount.
- If the earlier return had been posted 14 months ago, today's return would be the only one in the rolling 12 months and the count would be 1.
